description: Inventory file in inventory/ with its own group_vars/host_vars, playbook-level group_vars/host_vars in the project root (the playbook dir). One variable per precedence pair: L4<L5, L5<L6, L7<L9, L9<L10.
notes: host-cwd-is-project equals host-pbdir: without --export, ansible-inventory loads the cwd's group_vars/host_vars at the playbook level even when --playbook-dir is not given (the loader basedir defaults to the cwd). With --export only --playbook-dir adds them.
ansible-playbook site.yml gives the same values as host-pbdir (verified in the research probe 07).
